scope: Saved seed0 val trajectories, 21-frame history, future32 at dt=.1; no model execution, no fitting or training

definitions.raw_latent_norms: Only compare predicted/observed within each model; coordinate scales differ across methods
definitions.variance: Population mean square per coordinate; total = within time per trajectory + between trajectory means; all33 time points equally weighted
definitions.exact_plateau: Adjacent wrapped angle and/or speed differences <=1e-12; >=1s means >=10 consecutive intervals
definitions.dynamic_plateau: Exact angle plateau overlaps 1s truth speed RMS >.1 times train-fit omega scale
definitions.hjepa_state: First32 features are control state; last32 are model-specific causal state increment, NOT physical omega
definitions.hjepa_observed_delta_caveat: Observed-history pre-anchor repeats leftmost frame; each history is rebuilt. Delta differences must not be substituted for state-dynamics evidence
definitions.distance: Stored nearest-fit distance is Euclidean after the original train-only standardization
definitions.readout_limit: Readout.npz and neighbor IDs are absent locally; exact repeated decoded values support quantization but identical neighbor IDs cannot be directly verified
